sentences.text: Dev Raj vs State Of Himachal Pradesh on 16 March, 2024
Dev Raj Versus State of Himachal Pradesh .

Present: Mr. J.L. Bhardwaj, Sr. Advocate along with Mr. Anil
Kumar, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Prashant Sen, Deputy Advocate General, for the respondent.
Mr. Prashant Sen, learned Deputy Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent.
He prays for and is granted three weeks time to file status report.

The petitioner [Dev Raj] has come up before this Court seeking pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure [hereinafter referred to as 'Cr.P.C.'] originating from FIR No.11 of 2024, under Sections 376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code [hereinafter referred to as 'IPC'],
registered at Mahila Police Station Mandi, Tehsil Sadar, District Mandi (H.P.)
4.

entities.text: Mahila Police Station Mandi, Tehsil Sadar, District Mandi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The case set up by the bail petitioner- accused [Dev Raj] is that he is a resident of Village Chanehad, P.O. Bihun, Tehsil Joginder Nagar,
District Mandi.
It is averred in Para 2 of the bail petition that the petitioner is not at all connected with the allegations in the FIR.

The allegations in .
the FIR are stated to be false, frivolous and baseless.
5. The bail petitioner has given the undertaking that he shall participate in investigation as and when called.

The undertaking has further been furnished that the bail petitioner shall not cause any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case or the witnesses in any manner.

It is further averred in the bail petition that the FIR is a result of the alleged threats,
inter se between the parties.
6. In this background, the bail petitioner has further averred that he is innocent and has been falsely implicated and he has no connection with the alleged offence.
The conduct of the bail petitioner has also remained unblemished throughout without there being any criminal record.
